public.hero.title: Inqanaba lesityalo, libalwa ngemozulu eyenzekileyo
public.hero.intro: Mecropolis idibanisa iintsuku zobushushu bokukhula kumaqondo obushushu abhalwe yi-Open-Meteo ukususela ekutyaleni, ize ihambise ixesha lokulima ngalinye laseNtshona Koloni kwinqanaba elilandelayo xa isixa sidlula kumda wesityalo.

public.how.title: Ukusuka kumhla wokutyala ukuya kwinqanaba
public.how.lead: Inqanaba lidla ngokufakwa ngesandla, ngoko libonisa uhlaziyo lokugqibela kuphela. Apha libalwa ngemozulu ebhaliweyo, kwaye utshintsho ngalunye lugcina ubungqina balo.
public.step.1.title: Bhala oko kwaziwa ngumlimi
public.step.1.body: Iifama, amasimi, izityalo nemihla yokutyala zigcinwa kwi-Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Landa imozulu eyenzekileyo
public.step.2.body: Amaqondo obushushu emihla ngemihla kwindawo yentsimi avela kwindawo yokugcina ye-Open-Meteo, ukususela ekutyaleni ukuza kuthi ga namhlanje.
public.step.3.title: Dibanisa iintsuku zobushushu
public.step.3.body: Iintsuku zobushushu bokukhula (GDD) zidityaniswa ngokwemodeli yesityalo. Xa kudlulwa umda, inkqubo ihambisa ixesha lokulima kwinqanaba elilandelayo ize ibhale isizathu.
public.models.title: Iimodeli zezityalo ezisetyenziswayo
public.models.lead: Iintsuku zobushushu ezifunekayo ukuze isityalo sivuthwe. La manani abhalwe ngesandla kwaye akakabi namithombo.
public.live.title: Imeko kwifama yomboniso yaseSwartland
public.live.lead: Imilinganiselo evela kwimithombo kawonke-wonke, ihlaziywa rhoqo emva kwemizuzu engama-30.
public.yields.title: Imilinganiselo yesivuno epapashiweyo
public.honesty.title: Indlela ephathwa ngayo idatha
public.honesty.1.title: Isivuno sifakwa ngumsebenzisi
public.honesty.1.body: De umlimi abhale isivuno, i-app ibonisa “Asikabhalwa”.
public.honesty.2.title: Imilinganiselo ziirekhodi ezahlukileyo
public.honesty.2.body: Iinkcukacha-manani zengingqi nezelizwe zigcinwa kumaxwebhu azo, kunye nomthombo neyunithi. Azithelekiswa nesivuno sentsimi.
public.honesty.3.title: Iirekhodi zezitshabalalisi zezengingqi
public.honesty.3.body: Iirekhodi zeGBIF zibonisa apho izitshabalalisi zabonwa khona phakathi kwe-100 km, kunye nomgama.
public.honesty.4.title: Imozulu yeyangoku
public.honesty.4.body: Amaqondo obushushu athathwa kwindawo yokugcina ye-Open-Meteo xa ecelwa.
public.open.title: Vula ixesha lokulima
public.open.body: Ngena kwideshibhodi yedemo ukuze ubone igophe le-GDD lexesha lokulima nobungqina benqanaba lalo.
public.live.unavailable: Idatha ye-{source} ayifumaneki ngoku ({reason}). Akukho nto iboniswa endaweni yayo.

public.live.weatherChart: Obona bushushu buphantsi nobuphezulu bemihla ngemihla nemvula yexesha eliqikelelweyo
public.live.pestsLead: Iirekhodi ezineendawo ezichaziweyo phakathi kwe-{radius} km ukusuka efama.
public.yield.lead: Ezi seti zintathu zilinganisa izinto ezahlukileyo kumanqanaba ahlukileyo. Azinakuthelekiswa enye nenye okanye nayo nayiphi na intsimi.
public.about.title: Malunga
public.about.heading: Malunga neMecropolis
public.about.lead: IMecropolis ilandelela amasimi nezityalo zefama eseNtshona Koloni.
public.about.why.title: Kutheni ikhona
public.about.why.body: Amanqanaba entsimi ayaphelelwa lixesha, nezivuno zibhalwa ngokukhunjulwa. IMecropolis ibala inqanaba ngemozulu erekhodiweyo. Inani ngalinye livela kumlimi okanye kumthombo woluntu ochaziweyo.
public.about.design.title: Indlela eyakhiwe ngayo
public.about.design.1.body: Iiyunithi zobushushu (GDD) ziqokelelwa ukususela kumhla wokutyala kusetyenziswa indawo yokugcina ye-Open-Meteo. Xa inqanaba litshintsha, kugcinwa ubungqina: umhla eliqale ngawo, i-GDD iyonke nento elibalwe ngayo.
public.about.design.2.body: Inqanaba elilandela elaphambi kokuvuna libizwa ngokuba kukuvuthwa ngobushushu, kuba akukho siganeko sokuvuna sirekhodiweyo.
public.about.design.4.body: Igcinwa kumaxwebhu ayo, kunye nomthombo, iyunithi nelayisensi.
public.about.stack.title: Itekhnoloji
public.about.stack.body: Yi-app yephepha elinye yeVite neReact 19 ekwiCloudflare Pages. Isikhangeli sifunda ngqo idatha yoluntu yeSanity ngeGROQ nangomphulaphuli wexesha lokwenene. Ukubhala nedatha eneqhosha kudlula kwiCloudflare Pages Functions, ezijonga i-cookie yeseshoni esayiniweyo. Kusetyenziswa iZod kwimida, iVitest kuvavanyo neTailwind 4 kwinkangeleko.
public.about.limits.title: Izithintelo ezaziwayo
public.about.limits.1: Amaxabiso emodeli yesityalo (ubushushu obusisiseko, ixesha lobushushu lokuntshula nelokuvuthwa) abhalwe ngesandla kwaye awakabi nayo imithombo.
public.about.limits.2: Umlinganiselo welupin uvela kwiHarvestStat yeminyaka ka-2000 ukuya ku-2007 kuphela, kwaye ukufakwa kwedatha yokuqala akufumananga maxwebhu omlinganiselo welupin.
public.about.limits.3: Idatha yezitshabalalisi ziirekhodi zeGBIF ezikufutshane nefama. Zibonisa apho uhlobo oluthile lwarekhodwa khona kufutshane nefama.
public.about.limits.4: Idemo isebenzisa iakhawunti enye ekwabelwana ngayo nesithinteli sezicelo esigcinwe kwimemori. Ukungena kufihla amaphepha edeshibhodi kodwa akukhuseli idatha: wonke umntu angayifunda. Kodwa kukhusela konke okubhalwayo.

docs.title: Amaxwebhu
docs.heading: Ukuseta ne-API
docs.lead: Indlela yokusebenzisa iMecropolis kwikhompyutha yakho nento eyenziwa ziindawo zayo zonxibelelwano.
docs.setup.title: Ukuseta
docs.setup.serves: I-app isebenza ku-{0}, ize idlulisele u-{1} kwiPages Functions eku-{2}. Useto lwesikhangeli lufundwa ngemodyuli enye, iFunctions yona iqinisekisa olwayo; akukho nanye eqalayo xa kukho ixabiso elingekhoyo.
docs.env.title: Amaxabiso oseto
docs.env.fasKey: Ukufikelela kwiUSDA FAS PSD, kweFunctions kuphela
docs.stages.title: Inkqubo yamanqanaba
docs.stages.intro: Amaxesha okulima adlula kula manqanaba mathandathu:
docs.stages.guards: Ukudlulela kwinqanaba ngalinye kunemiqathango. Elityaliweyo lifuna umhla wokutyala nesityalo; elikhulayo lifuna umda weeyunithi zobushushu wokuntshula; elaphambi kokuvuna lifuna i-90% yomda wokuvuthwa; ukuvuthwa ngobushushu kufuna ukufikelela kumda wokuvuthwa; ukuphonononga kufuna umfanekiso wemozulu wexesha lokulima nomlinganiselo oqinisekisiweyo. Imiqathango ye-GDD ikwafuna idatha yobushushu ubuncinane kwi-90% yexesha, kwaye utshintsho olunomhla wokuqalisa wexesha elizayo luyathintelwa.
docs.endpoints.title: Iindawo zonxibelelwano
docs.endpoints.errors: Iimpazamo zibuyisa {0}. Ukubhala kufuna nesicelo esivela kwakule sayithi.
docs.ep.advance: Qhubela ixesha lokulima phambili (iseshoni ifuna seasonId), okanye ngesitshixo, uqhube onke amaxesha okulima phambili ngokwe-GDD
docs.ep.scenario: Ubalo lwe-GDD lokuzama imeko; akukho nto igcinwayo
docs.ep.weather: Uqikelelo, imbali okanye ingqikelelo yemozulu yentsimi
docs.ep.pests: Izitshabalalisi ezibonwe kwingingqi kwi-GBIF; i-POST iyazigcina
docs.ep.landing: Imozulu, umhlaba, izitshabalalisi nezivuno zefama yomzekelo
docs.seed.title: Ukufaka idatha yokuqala
docs.seed.body: {0} ifaka ifama yomzekelo, amasimi, izityalo namaxesha okulima kwidatha emiselweyo, ize ihambelanise nemilinganiselo yengingqi. Ithatha indawo yefama, amasimi nezityalo, ngoko yisebenzise kuphela kwidatha eyeyakho.
guide.title: Uyisebenzisa njani iMecropolis
guide.lead: Isikhokelo esifutshane nesilula. Sichaza ukuba le app yeyantoni, yeyabani nokuba icandelo ngalinye lenza ntoni.
guide.what.title: Yintoni iMecropolis
guide.what.p1: IMecropolis ilandelela amasimi nezityalo zasefama. Ibala ukuba isityalo sikhule kangakanani ngokudibanisa ubushushu esibufumene ukususela ekutyalweni. Ikwabonisa imozulu, umhlaba nezitshabalalisi ezikufutshane nefama yakho ndawonye.
guide.what.p2: Yenzelwe iifama zaseNtshona Koloni eMzantsi Afrika, kodwa ingasetyenziswa kuyo nayiphi ifama, ingingqi okanye ixesha lokulima.
guide.who.title: Yenzelwe bani
guide.who.p1: Yenzelwe umntu ojonga amasimi, njengomfama, umphathi wefama okanye umcebisi wabo.
guide.who.p2: Akuyomfuneko ukuba wazi ngeekhompyutha okanye inzululwazi yemozulu. Ukuba uyakwazi ukuvula iwebhusayithi, ungayisebenzisa iMecropolis.
guide.why.title: Kutheni ungayisebenzisa
guide.why.1: Ungabona ngokukhawuleza ukuba zeziphi izityalo ezisandul' ukutyalwa, ezikhulayo nezisele ziza kulungela ukuvunwa.
guide.why.2: Akuyomfuneko ukuhlaziya intsimi nganye ngesandla. I-app izisa isityalo kwinqanaba elilandelayo xa imozulu ibonisa ukuba lixesha.
guide.why.3: Ikulumkisa ngeqabaka nobushushu obuzayo, nangezitshabalalisi ezibonwe kufutshane nefama yakho.
guide.why.4: Yonke ingxelo yentsimi, njengokutshiza, isitshabalalisi osibonileyo okanye inqaku, igcinwa ndawonye nomhla wayo ukuze uyijonge kamva.
guide.why.5: Inani ngalinye libonisa apho livela khona, ukuze wazi ukuba leliphi onokulithemba.
guide.heat.title: I-app ilazi njani inqanaba lesityalo
guide.heat.p1: Izityalo zikhula ngokukhawuleza xa kushushu, zicothe xa kubanda. IMecropolis ibala obu bushushu yonke imihla njengeeyunithi zobushushu, ezibizwa zizazinzulu ngokuba zi-growing degree days okanye GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Suku ngalunye ithatha iqondo eliphakathi kwelona liphezulu nelona lisezantsi, ize isuse iqondo apho isityalo siyeka ukukhula khona. Okushiyekileyo ziiyunithi zobushushu zaloo mini. Usuku olubandayo alongezi nto.
guide.heat.p3: Isityalo ngasinye sifuna inani elithile leeyunithi zobushushu ngaphambi kokuba silunge. Xa inani eliqokelelwe ukususela ekutyalweni lisondela kwelo nani, isityalo siya kwinqanaba elilandelayo.
guide.heat.p4: Amaqondo obushushu avela kwi-Open-Meteo, inkonzo yemozulu yasimahla egcina imozulu yeendawo zonke emhlabeni.
guide.stages.title: Amanqanaba amathandathu
guide.stages.intro: Isityalo ngasinye kwintsimi nganye sidlula kula manqanaba ngokulandelelana.
guide.stages.planning: Ixesha lokulima licwangcisiwe, kodwa isityalo asikatyalwa.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Isityalo siqokelele phantse bonke ubushushu esibufunayo, ngoko lixesha lokulungiselela ukuvuna.
guide.stages.harvested: Isityalo siqokelele bonke ubushushu esibufunayo, ngoko kufanele ukuba silungele ukuvunwa. Nguwe kuphela onokuqinisekisa ukuba sivuniwe, ngoko i-app ithi sivuthwe ngokobushushu.
guide.stages.review: Ixesha lokulima liphelile, ungajonga ukuba lihambe njani.
guide.stages.p2: I-app ijonga isityalo ngasinye qho ebusuku naxa umntu efaka into ayibonileyo okanye umsebenzi awenzileyo. Ungacofa u-Hlaziya ngoku kwixesha lokulima ukuze ijonge ngoko nangoko.
guide.start.title: Ukuqalisa
guide.start.1: Vula iphepha lasekhaya. Ungabona imephu yemozulu, umhlaba, izitshabalalisi nezivuno zefama yomzekelo ungakhange ungene.
guide.start.2: Cofa u-Ngena phezulu, usebenzise iinkcukacha zeakhawunti yomzekelo ozinikiweyo.
guide.start.3: Khetha ifama. Oku kuvula ideshibhodi yaloo fama.
guide.start.4: Cofa ixesha lokulima ukuze ubone yonke into ngesityalo esinye kwintsimi enye.
guide.start.5: Sebenzisa ibhokisi yolwimi ephezulu kulo naliphi iphepha ukutshintsha ulwimi. I-app iyakukhumbula ukhetho lwakho kwixesha elizayo.
guide.home.title: Iphepha lasekhaya
guide.home.p1: Iphepha lasekhaya libonisa imephu yengingqi enemibala ebonisa ubushushu obufunyenwe ngumhlaba kweli xesha lokulima. Likwabonisa imozulu yangoku neyeentsuku ezizayo, umhlaba wefama yomzekelo, izitshabalalisi ezisandul' ukubonwa kufutshane nezivuno eziqhelekileyo zengingqi. Akuyomfuneko ukuba ungene ukuze ukubone.
guide.dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi yefama
guide.dashboard.intro: Ideshibhodi ibonisa ifama enye. La ngamacandelo ayo ukusuka phezulu ukuya ezantsi. Ibhokisi yefama ephezulu ikuvumela ukuba uye kwenye ifama.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Isishwankathelo sefama
guide.dashboard.summary: Inani lamasimi neehektare zefama, amaxesha okulima aqhubayo nezityalo ezilungele ukuvunwa.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Kufuna ukujongwa
guide.dashboard.alerts: Izilumkiso ezimfutshane, njengeqabaka okanye ubushushu obuqikelelweyo, isityalo esilungeleyo, ixesha lokulima elingaqalanga ngexesha okanye izitshabalalisi ezibonwe kufutshane nentsimi. Isilumkiso ngasinye sichaza unobangela.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Imeko yefama
guide.dashboard.conditions: Imozulu yanamhlanje, uqikelelo, umhlaba nezitshabalalisi ezikufutshane nale fama.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Inkqubela yexesha lokulima
guide.dashboard.progress: Ikhadi lesityalo ngasinye elibonisa ubushushu esele sibuqokelele. Ungathelekisa amasimi uze ukhuphele uluhlu njengefayile yespredishithi (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Amasimi
guide.dashboard.fields: Onke amasimi efama, ubukhulu bawo, umhlaba wawo nezityalo zawo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Khangela iingxelo
guide.dashboard.search: Bhala into oyikhangelayo ngamazwi aqhelekileyo, njengentwala yengqolowa. Ikhangela izinto ezibonwe entsimini nemisebenzi eyenziweyo enentsingiselo efanayo, nokuba kubhalwe ngamanye amagama.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Iingcebiso
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Imisebenzi ecetyiswayo entsimini, njengokutshiza okanye ukufaka isichumiso. Ungayamkela okanye uyale nganye, uze uyiphawule njengegqityiweyo xa umsebenzi ugqityiwe.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Okwenzeke kutshanje
guide.dashboard.activity: Uluhlu lwemihla isityalo ngasinye esiye ngayo kwinqanaba elitsha.
guide.season.title: Iphepha lexesha lokulima
guide.season.intro: Ixesha lokulima sisityalo esinye kwintsimi enye ngonyaka omnye. Iphepha lalo linayo yonke ingcaciso ngalo.
guide.season.top.label: Phezulu ephepheni
guide.season.top: Isityalo, intsimi, umhla wokutyala, umhla olindeleke wokuvuna nesivuno xa sele usifakile.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Ulandelelwano lwamanqanaba
guide.season.pipeline: Amanqanaba amathandathu, kuphawulwe eli langoku. Cofa u-Hlaziya ngoku ukuze ijonge ngoko nangoko ukuba isityalo sifanele ukuya kwelinye inqanaba na.
guide.season.readiness.label: Ukulungela isigqibo
guide.season.readiness: Uluhlu lwezinto ezifunwa yi-app ngaphambi kokuba isise isityalo kwelinye inqanaba, njengomhla wokutyala nedatha yemozulu eyaneleyo. Into nganye ithi Ilungile, Isilumkiso okanye Ivaliwe. Into evaliweyo ichaza into engekhoyo.
guide.season.evidence.label: Ubungqina
guide.season.evidence: Iingxelo ezisetyenziswe yi-app ukwenza izigqibo, ukuze uzihlole.
guide.season.propose.label: Cebisa umsebenzi
guide.season.propose: Cebisa umsebenzi wale ntsimi, uze uqhoboshele ubungqina bexesha lokulima. Uhlala uyidrafti de umntu awamkele kwideshibhodi.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Itshathi ebonisa iiyunithi zobushushu eziqokelelwe ukususela ekutyalweni, nomgca obonisa inani elifunwa sisityalo.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Kuthekani ukuba?
guide.season.whatIf: Zama umhla wokutyala ongaphambili okanye osemva, okanye ixesha lokulima elishushu okanye elibandayo, ubone ukuba iiyunithi zobushushu zingatshintsha njani. Akukho nto igcinwayo.
guide.season.summary.label: Isishwankathelo sexesha lokulima
guide.season.summary: Isishwankathelo esifutshane seengxelo zexesha lokulima esibhalwe yi-AI. Sisebenzise njengoncedo, uze ujonge iingxelo xa kukho into engalunganga.
guide.season.notes.label: Amanqaku exesha lokulima
guide.season.notes: Amanqaku exesha lokulima anemihla. Ungawafaka, uwatshintshe, uwacime, okanye ubuyise inguqulelo endala yenqaku.
guide.season.files.label: Ifoto yentsimi nengxelo yovavanyo lomhlaba
guide.season.files: Faka ifoto yentsimi nengxelo yovavanyo lomhlaba eyi-PDF evela elebhu.
guide.season.log.label: Ingxelo yentsimi
guide.season.log: Into oyibonileyo entsimini nezinto ozenzileyo kuyo, njengokutshiza, kuquka imveliso nomlinganiselo wayo.
guide.season.history.label: Imbali yotshintsho
guide.season.history: Lonke utshintsho olugciniweyo kweli xesha lokulima nomhla walo.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Umlinganiselo wengingqi
guide.season.benchmark: Isivuno esiqhelekileyo sengingqi esivela kwiinkcukacha zoluntu. Sesokuthelekisa kuphela, ayisosivuno sentsimi yakho.
guide.season.pests.label: Izitshabalalisi ezibonwe kwingingqi
guide.season.pests: Izitshabalalisi ezixelwe kufutshane nentsimi kwi-GBIF, uvimba woluntu wezinto ezibonwe ngabantu. Cofa u-Landa ezisandul' ukubonwa ukuze ufumane ezamva nje.
guide.sources.title: Avela phi amanani
guide.sources.weather: Imozulu ivela kwi-Open-Meteo, eyanamhlanje, uqikelelo neentsuku ezidlulileyo.
guide.sources.soil: Iinkcukacha zomhlaba zivela kwi-SoilGrids, imephu yomhlaba yehlabathi.
guide.sources.pests: Izitshabalalisi ezibonwe ngabantu zivela kwi-GBIF, uvimba woluntu wezinto ezibonwe ngabantu.
guide.sources.yields: Izivuno zengingqi zivela kwi-USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa nakwi-World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Yonke enye into, njengamanqaku, imisebenzi eyenziweyo nezivuno zakho, ifakwe nguwe okanye liqela lakho.
guide.limits.title: Izinto engenakuzenza
guide.limits.model: Iiyunithi zobushushu ezifunwa sisityalo ngasinye luqikelelo lwethu, kwaye azikavavanywa entsimini. Zisebenzise njengesikhokelo, uthembe into oyibonayo entsimini yakho.
guide.limits.maturity: Ukuvuthwa ngobushushu kuthetha ukuba ngokwemozulu isityalo kufanele ukuba silungele ukuvunwa. Nguwe kuphela owaziyo ukuba sivuthwe nyhani na.
guide.limits.translation: Iinguqulelo zibhalwe yi-AI. Kufanele kube lula ukuziqonda, kodwa azikhange zihlolwe zonke sisithethi solwimi lwenkobe.
